resources.cpu_budget_rule: 20MPC workers plus about5vCPU of headroom for physical loop,JAX/Torch,RPC andI/O. This is a soft compute budget,not a guarantee that all framework threads total25 or25dedicated physical cores.

learning.evidence: Use normal update logs,real trajectories and saved checkpoint. Do not replace real learning by mock tests or inflate results into convergence/benefit claims.
